messages.author: 9ca666306da80fb9
messages.subject: Structured latent curve models
parts:
For more than twenty years I ignored the "structured latent curve model" approach proposed by Michael Browne:

Browne, M.W. (1993). Structured latent curve models. In: C.M. Cuadras and
C.R. Rao (Eds.), Multivariate analysis: future directions 2. (pp. 171-198).
Amsterdam: Elseviers Science Publishers.

Now it is time to dive into this subject. Are there a Lavaan/R script available?


The only thing I know is that Blozis provided a SAS syntax (but no data)

Blozis, Shelley 
A.Structured Latent Curve Models for the Study of Change in Multivariate Repeated Measures
Psychological Methods
 Issue: Volume 9(3), September 2004, p 334-353

http://supp.apa.org/psycarticles/supplemental/1082-989X.9.3.334/1082-989X.9.3.334_supp.html

TIA Harry

Hello Harry,

I have not tried this myself, but there is a SEM teacher's corner paper
on this using LISREL syntax:

https://www.researchgate.net/publication/233475685_Using_LISREL_to_fit_nonlinear_latent_curve_models/link/553a58840cf29b5ee4b6201a/download


From there, it should be possible to translate it to lavaan. I have no
time to try this out myself for the moment, but here is the LISREL syntax:
